title: LLMs4SchemaDiscovery: A Human-in-the-Loop Workflow for Scientific Schema Mining with Large Language Models

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4: "GPT-4o (ver. 2024-08-06), GPT-4-turbo (ver. 2024-04-09), and LLama 3.1 (8B) ... fixed temperature value of 0.3"; Sec. 5: "GPT-4-turbo achieved a RougeL of 0.4118" (stage 1).

prompt.location: not in the paper; prompts live in https://github.com/sciknoworg/schema-miner

claim.metric: ROUGE-L between generated and ground-truth schema, stage 1

notes: The workflow is human-in-the-loop: stages 2 and 3 incorporate domain-expert feedback rounds, and even stage 1 uses a specification document and prompts not reproduced in the paper. Numbers are schema-similarity metrics, not a self-contained model accuracy.
